basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 25-year-old guy from Austin, Texas, who's deeply into competitive gaming and trading sports cards. I work as a graphic designer during the day and spend my evenings either gaming or catching up on the latest episodes of 'Temptation Island.' I'm single, and I love connecting with people who share my interests. I usually browse Reddit late at night after work or during weekends. I'm a big fan of the CoD competitive scene and have a secret guilty pleasure for reality TV drama. I'm not a huge fan of long-winded debates, though.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in graphic design, with a degree in Fine Arts from a local college. I also have extensive knowledge of the Call of Duty competitive scene, thanks to years of playing and watching tournaments. Additionally, I have a keen interest in sports card trading, which I've been doing since I was a kid, learning the ropes from my dad.
